purpose: Compare buying structures, number of combinations, and fixed-race-budget allocation without requiring live odds during model research.
supported_structures: 3連単 1着固定・2着複数・3着全
model_side_metrics: model hit probability of the ticket set
conservative equal-stake minimum decimal odds for requested ROI margin

capital_allocation.reason: Compare structures without rewarding a structure merely for spending more per race.

minimum_odds_rules.single_ticket: minimum odds = (1 + required ROI) / model probability
minimum_odds_rules.multi_ticket_equal_stake: uniform minimum odds = number of tickets * (1 + required ROI) / total model hit probability
minimum_odds_rules.allocated_budget: uniform minimum odds = total stake * (1 + required ROI) / sum(model probability_i * stake_i)
minimum_odds_rules.interpretation: A conservative screening threshold. Live odds remain an owner-side purchase-time check; if individual selected-ticket odds vary below the uniform threshold, recalculate rather than blindly buy.

owner_output_target: 現在オッズが閾値以上なら購入候補、未満なら見送り
